failure_patterns.name: Deadlock / Timeout
failure_patterns.probable_cause: Deadlock in turn gate or wait

failure_patterns.name: Flaky / Race Condition
failure_patterns.next_step: Run test 5-10× in isolation to confirm; then add synchronization

failure_patterns.name: State Sync Bug
failure_patterns.probable_cause: State synchronization bug between expected and actual
failure_patterns.next_step: Check AdvanceOneTurnSafe() thread safety and state propagation

failure_patterns.name: Queue / Command Ordering
failure_patterns.probable_cause: Commands execute out of order; queue corruption
failure_patterns.next_step: Check BlockingCollection usage and queue semantics

failure_patterns.name: Uncaught Exception
failure_patterns.probable_cause: Exception in handler not caught or propagated incorrectly
failure_patterns.next_step: Check ExecuteCommandSafe() wrapper; ensure exceptions are caught

failure_patterns.name: Assertion Failure
failure_patterns.next_step: Review assertion message and test logic

cascade_rules.reason: Core state machine and thread safety bugs cascade into everything
Lifecycle bugs cascade into integration tests
